self-improvement-first.name: Self-Improvement & Strategy — 12 Month
self-improvement-first.description: Starts with habit science, moves through philosophy and strategy, rewards discipline with fiction at month 4. Sequenced to build momentum.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.why: The foundation of everything. Science of habit building — directly explains what you're building right now.

books.title: Ego is the Enemy
books.author: Ryan Holiday
books.why: Confronts the mental patterns that kill momentum before it starts. Read when motivation first dips.

books.title: The Four Agreements
books.author: Don Miguel Ruiz
books.why: Short enough to finish in 2 weeks. A quiet reset before fiction begins.

books.title: Red Rising
books.author: Pierce Brown
books.why: Reward month. Addictive pacing — placed here to reinforce the reading habit when it could stall. Series warning: Books 2 and 3 are equally good.

books.title: 12 Rules for Life
books.author: Jordan Peterson
books.why: Hits differently once you've been doing the work for 4 months. The rules feel earned, not prescriptive.

books.title: No Longer Human
books.author: Osamu Dazai
books.why: Short, dark, beautifully written. Perfect palate cleanser after Peterson.

books.title: The Richest Man in Babylon
books.author: George S. Clason
books.why: Very short. Financial mindset. Real estate career. Read same month as Dazai.

books.title: 48 Laws of Power
books.author: Robert Greene
books.why: Changes how you read every room and every conversation. One law per sitting — don't rush it.

books.title: Outliers
books.author: Malcolm Gladwell
books.why: Fast and gripping. Reframes what getting good actually requires — applies to fitness and career equally.

books.title: Mistborn
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.why: By Month 9 your volume is strong. Meticulous plotting, brilliant magic system. Also a trilogy.

books.title: Mastery
books.author: Robert Greene
books.why: Read when real discipline is built. You'll recognize yourself in the early-stage learner.

books.title: When Breath Becomes Air
books.author: Paul Kalanithi
books.why: Most profound book on the shelf. About meaning, time, what makes a life worth living.

books.title: Thinking Fast and Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.why: Hardest book here. Save for last — by Month 12 your focus handles it.

year2_flagship.title: The Way of Kings
year2_flagship.author: Brandon Sanderson
year2_flagship.note: Greatest epic fantasy written this century. Reward for completing Year 1. Do not start before Year 2.

business-focus.name: Business & Finance — 12 Month
business-focus.description: Practical business and financial intelligence. Heavy on real-world application for careers, investing, and building financial independence.

books.title: The Richest Man in Babylon
books.author: George S. Clason
books.why: Start small — this short book plants the seed for everything financial that follows.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.why: Building financial habits is building any habit — this is the framework.

books.title: 48 Laws of Power
books.author: Robert Greene
books.why: Power dynamics in business — read one law per sitting.

books.title: Outliers
books.author: Malcolm Gladwell
books.why: What actually drives success — dispels the myths.

books.title: The Tipping Point
books.author: Malcolm Gladwell
books.why: How ideas spread — useful for any sales or marketing role including real estate.

books.title: Influence: The Psychology of Persuasion
books.author: Robert Cialdini
books.why: The bible of persuasion. Career-changing for anyone in sales.

books.title: Mastery
books.author: Robert Greene
books.why: What becoming world-class actually looks like. Long game thinking.

books.title: Thinking Fast and Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.why: How decisions are made — essential for negotiation and investing.

books.title: Ego is the Enemy
books.author: Ryan Holiday
books.why: Keeps ambition grounded — important when things start going well.

books.title: The Four Agreements
books.author: Don Miguel Ruiz
books.why: Mental clarity for high-performance — short and powerful.

books.title: Red Rising
books.author: Pierce Brown
books.why: Reward month — earn it with 10 months of non-fiction.

books.title: The Daily Laws
books.author: Robert Greene
books.why: One entry per day — end the year with Greene's wisdom distilled.

fiction-first.name: Fiction-Led with Growth — 12 Month
fiction-first.description: Fiction-heavy plan that still delivers real intellectual growth. Best for readers who need engaging stories to build the reading habit before heavier non-fiction.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.why: Start with this regardless of preference — it explains why you're building the reading habit at all.

books.title: Red Rising
books.author: Pierce Brown
books.why: Month 2 reward — get hooked on reading with this addictive series.

books.title: Golden Son
books.author: Pierce Brown
books.why: Series continuation — the momentum is too strong to stop.

books.title: Morning Star
books.author: Pierce Brown
books.why: Series finale. One of the great trilogy conclusions.

books.title: The Four Agreements
books.author: Don Miguel Ruiz
books.why: Short break after the Red Rising trilogy. Powerful and quick.

books.title: No Longer Human
books.author: Osamu Dazai
books.why: Dark literary fiction — completely different tone, worth it.

books.title: Ego is the Enemy
books.author: Ryan Holiday
books.why: First real non-fiction push — you're ready for it now.

books.title: Mistborn
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.why: Epic fantasy with incredible world-building. Trilogy.

books.title: Outliers
books.author: Malcolm Gladwell
books.why: Reads like a series of fascinating stories — easy non-fiction transition.

books.title: 48 Laws of Power
books.author: Robert Greene
books.why: Read one law per sitting — can be done alongside other reading.

books.title: When Breath Becomes Air
books.author: Paul Kalanithi
books.why: Memoir that reads like beautiful fiction. Profound.

books.title: Mastery
books.author: Robert Greene
books.why: End the year with the long game. You've built the habit — now build the skill.
